rationale_summary: The document is a contract guideline from Japan's Ministry of Agriculture aimed at promoting data utilization and protecting agricultural know-how in AI development. The primary framing is enabling innovation—facilitating AI adoption in agriculture through clear contract frameworks, IP protection, and data sharing arrangements. Economic competitiveness appears as a secondary frame through references to AI Strategy 2019 goals and commercialization. Consumer/public safety appears modestly through liability and personal data handling provisions.
